scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck:api
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:edge
scripts.check:edge: deno check --config supabase/functions/chat/deno.json supabase/functions/chat/index.ts && deno lint --config supabase/functions/chat/deno.json supabase/functions/chat/
